openwrt_git_support.nachricht:
ath79: add support for Comfast CF-EW71 v2

Specifications:
Qualcomm/Atheros QCA9531
2x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet, with 48v PoE
2T2R 2.4 GHz, 802.11b/g/n
128MB RAM
16MB SPI Flash
4x LED (Always On Power, LAN, WAN, WLAN)

Flashing instructions:
The original firmware is based on OpenWrt, so flashing the sysupgrade image over the factory firmware is sufficient.
The bootloader has a built-in recovery web-ui. This is the method I used to flash OpenWrt. You can get to the recovery web-ui by holding down the reset button for a few seconds (~5s) while pluggin in the router. The LEDs should start blinking fast and the router should be available on 192.168.1.1 for the recovery.

Tested: Reset button, WAN LED, LAN LED, Power LED (always on, not much to test), WLAN LED, MAC addresses (same as factory firmware).

Signed-off-by: Felix Golatofski <git@xdfr.de>

 	ucidef_set_led_switch "lan4" "LAN4" "blue:lan4" "switch0" "0x10"
 	;;
+comfast,cf-ew71-v2|\

openwrt_git_leds.nachricht:
ath79: fix LED GPIOs for COMFAST CF-EW71 v2

The vendor DTS defined incorrect GPIOs for the LEDs, which caused them
to not function properly. Initially, the WAN, WLAN LEDs appeared to
work, but further testing showed that they were non-functional.

This patch corrects the GPIO assignments in the DTS, restoring full LED
functionality including blinking, except the power LED which cannot be
software controlled.

Tested on a CF-EW71 v2 unit.

Fixes: ee3a6adc6c22 ("ath79: add support for Comfast CF-EW71 v2")
Signed-off-by: Felix Golatofski <git@xdfr.de>
Link: https://github.com/openwrt/openwrt/pull/19665
Signed-off-by: Hauke Mehrtens <hauke@hauke-m.de>

comfast_quellcode.nachricht:
COMFAST CF-EW71/CF-EW72 is a outdoor AP with PoE support, based on
Qualcomm/Atheros QCA9531(EW71) or QCA9531 + QCA9886(EW72).

Short specification:

    2x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet, with 48v PoE support
    64 MB of RAM (DDR2)
    16 MB of FLASH (SPI)
    2T2R 2.4 GHz, 802.11b/g/n
    2T2R 5.8 GHz, 802.11a(EW72 only), support wave 2
    built-in 2x 3 dBi antennas
    output power (max): 500 mW (27 dBm)

Flash instruction:

Original firmware is based on OpenWrt.
Use sysupgrade image directly in vendor GUI.

Signed-off-by: Ding Tengfei <dtf@comfast.cn>

auszug: The CF-EW71 V2 is a high-power outdoor wireless access point, delivering 300Mbps speed and extensive coverage. Its rugged IP66-rated housing withstands harsh weather, and PoE support allows for flexible deployment. With high-gain antennas, it provides stable and reliable wireless connectivity for large outdoor areas like squares, parks, and scenic spots.
IP66 protection against rain, dust, and harsh weather
High 500mW (27dBm) transmit power for wide coverage
Standard PoE support for flexible and easy deployment
Flexible Fat AP and Fit AP modes for different needs
Adjustable transmit power to optimize signal quality
Scheduled reboot and config backup for easy maintenance
inhalt: 360° omnidirectional coverage
The device has two external oxygen-free copper antennas and 360
omnidirectional coverage to meet the needs of various scenarios
Built-in PA, high power
Equipped with PA (power amplifier) to improve wireless transmission and reception performance,
suitable for outdoor large area coverage
50+ High belt machine
A single AP can hold 50 terminal devices online at the same time, and ensure fast,
stable and smooth Internet access
Fighting harsh outdoor environments
Outdoor IP66 protection grade Withstands many complex and rugged outdoor environments
100m POE power supply
Support POE network cable power supply, flexible installation of outdoor engineering,
get rid of restrictions, power supply distance of 100 meters
Seamless roaming, automatic switching
Outdoor AP support seamless roaming, and the AP are managed by the AC.
Users can achieve zero-aware handover regardless of which AP they go
AC management
Support unified management and configuration of COMFAST wireless outdoor APs,
upgrades, data query, etc., Simultaneously can manage AP

lauf.notiz: Kein Eintrag im lokalen ToH-Dump 2026-10-18; Live-hwdata-Seite (Rev. 2026-04-30) übernommen. OpenWrt-Commits ee3a6adc (Support), 9ce23ac8 (LED-GPIOs), 7f3537ee (Label-MAC eth1), PR 14459, Hersteller-Quellcode 2019, Gluon-PR 3531/Commit 73c3a62 (Outdoor, factory=false, ab v2025.1).
